solutionSql:
SELECT shipment_id,
       id AS event_id,
       FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
         LEAD(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY occurred_at, id) - occurred_at
       )))::integer AS seconds_to_next
FROM shipment_events
ORDER BY shipment_id, occurred_at, id;

ambiguities.phrase: return the whole seconds from its occurred_at to the next scan
ambiguities.readingChosen: Truncate the fraction (FLOOR) of the elapsed time.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Round to the nearest whole second. Identical on the sample, where every event time is a whole hour.

ambiguities.phrase: Order scans by occurred_at, then by id.
ambiguities.readingChosen: The next scan is the next row in that order, so a scan tied with the following one gets 0 seconds (24 sample rows).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: The next scan must be strictly later in time, so a tied scan with no later scan gets NULL. Those 24 rows would change from 0 to NULL.

notes: The sample has 218 NULLs (last scan per shipment) and 24 zero-second ties from arrived and delivered sharing a timestamp. Only the tie reading is submitted.
